integrity: The all-rank proof is reconstructed using an integral congruence, exact finite-group stabilizers, a toric class-group sequence and the interior-lattice discrepancy formula. Finite integer replay is corroborative only; no independent validation has been performed.
limitations: Characteristic zero and the affine type-A Lipman semigroup only. Singular locus as a reduced support, generic formal transverse quotient and torus-fixed minimal log discrepancy. No positive-characteristic statement, D/E classification, Jacobian scheme or global resolution. The 2007 weighted-graphs article was not accessible in full; related unindexed computations remain possible.
title: Prime-indexed singular strata and discrepancies of type-\(A_n\) Lipman toric varieties
